={

nodes.notes: Industry standard: Log all SMS fallback errors to error_logs table

nodes.name: Error Handler: Return Error Response
nodes.notes: Industry standard: Return error response for SMS fallback failures

notes:
✅ REFACTORED: Uses native n8n HTTP Request nodes for SMS provider API and Supabase. No custom services. See docs/NATIVE_INTEGRATIONS.md

✅ ERROR HANDLING: Industry-standard error handling for SMS fallback:
- Error classification (needs review, critical)
- Error logging to error_logs table
- No retry logic (SMS is already a fallback)
- Error response returned to caller
- Connected via On Error outputs from HTTP Request nodes
